title: Curious Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: A small, wide-eyed cuttlefish whose skin ripples with looping, almost-legible handwriting whenever something new drifts by, as if it were taking careful notes on the world. It spends its days in soft amber light among swaying sea-grass, sorting a collection of sea glass into ever-changing patterns and pausing to consider each piece before setting it down just so.
